lcc_original: 你必汗流滿面、纔得喫食，直到你歸了土，因爲你是由土取出來的：你本是塵土，仍要歸於塵土。』
notes: 糊口 (UNV) → 喫食 (LCC): both express eating bread/food; all three SNs (WH0398 אָכַל eat + WTH8799 morphology + WH03899 לֶחֶם bread) appended after 喫食
從<WAH04480> (UNV) → 由<WAH04480> (LCC): equivalent prepositions meaning 'from'; WAH04480 attaches to 由
而出的<WH03947><WTH8795> (UNV) → 取出來的<WH03947><WTH8795> (LCC): LCC renders לָקַח more explicitly as 取出來, SNs appended at end of phrase
{<WAH0413>} kept implicit before first 土: LCC '歸了土' has no explicit preposition word, same structural gap as UNV
UNV clause boundary 。 becomes ： in LCC before the second 你 clause — punctuation preserved as-is per rules
